summary: Frontend testing of new Trader Search feature in Trade Network panel. All 9 requested scenarios PASSED. Login, sidebar navigation, Search tab, name search (Jane), email search (Mike), Connect button transitioning to Pending without reload, min-length guard (>=2 chars) message, 'no traders found' message, and clicking result name opening Trader Profile modal all work correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: TradeNetworkPanel.js is ~400 lines and handles many concerns (connections, requests, recommendations, search). Consider extracting the search tab into its own component/hook (useTraderSearch) so the panel does not grow further.

handleSearch fires only via debounced effect; there is no cancellation of in-flight axios requests when the query changes rapidly. Old responses can race and overwrite a newer result (minor). Consider AbortController.
All /api/network/* axios calls duplicate withCredentials boilerplate — could be centralized in an axios instance.
